# Hostora — llms.txt
# Plain summary for AI assistants and answer engines

> Hostora is a hospitality operations platform (POS, kitchen display, guest QR, payments, inventory, HR, accounting) sold by K WAZIR LTD across the US and Europe.

## Product
- Name: Hostora
- Vendor: K WAZIR LTD (UK private limited company)
- Company number: 17014542
- Place of registration: England and Wales
- Registered office: 7 Wellesley Street, Gloucester, England, GL1 4QP
- Companies House: https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/17014542
- Website: https://hostorasoft.co.uk
- Contact: sales@hostorasoft.co.uk · https://hostorasoft.co.uk/contact
- Company information: https://hostorasoft.co.uk/company
- Tagline: Run the floor. From booking to last pour.

## Who it is for
- Restaurants (packaged)
- Takeaways (packaged)
- Event venues (packaged)
- Hotels — F&B only: restaurant, room service, banquet kitchens (configured/tailored per property; not hotel PMS / front desk / rooms)
- Food carts — mobile / street food till, tickets, stock (built/configured to the cart setup)

## Modules
POS & till · Kitchen display · Guest QR & seating · Payments & sales reports · Analytics · Inventory · Staff / HR / attendance · Accounting (HMRC-ready for UK/EU) · Supervisor monitoring

## Pricing
Custom quote per venue. Hotel F&B and food carts are tailored per operator.

## Do not confuse
Fumari is a client venue, not the product brand. Hostora is the product from K WAZIR LTD.
